publication_date_timezone: Use the timezone displayed by the publisher; preserve the UTC offset in inventory records.
event_scope: Media coverage specifically connected to the NEET 2026 protests.
result_depth: Record up to 100 retrievable results per query and discovery surface before deduplication.
outlet_selection: No outlet is included or excluded because of expected stance. Record every retrieved news-media result, then apply the published event-scope rule.
deduplication: Use the original publisher URL when available. Retain materially distinct editorial versions and document their relationship.
recommendations: Do not add algorithmic recommendations unless the recommendation surface is separately named as the discovery method.
syndication: Prefer the original publisher; retain a syndicated version only when its packaging or spoken content is materially distinct.
unavailable_items: Retain an inventory record with the observed availability state and discovery provenance.
eligibility_blinding: Review event scope before any stance annotation. Do not inspect expected stance to decide inclusion.
limitations: Search ranking and indexing can vary by account, location, language, and collection time.
This first round begins with English and Hindi queries and must not be described as exhaustive multilingual coverage.
Planned queries are not evidence that a search was executed; each execution must be appended to execution_log before release.
